MUST: import the REAL data layer (app.db.get_session, app.models) -- never a mock, placeholder or in-memory stand-in (hollow rule, zo_sentinel/gates/hollow.py). MUST: write only files under services/staged/circuit_breaker_state_api/. MUST NOT: edit zo_sentinel/__init__.py, app/__init__.py, the Dockerfile, or any file outside the service directory. MUST NOT: import duckdb. MUST NOT: add a `_v2`/`_v3` sibling -- repair THIS directory.
